notes: Airtable is not the core database or execution environment.
This snapshot preserves table, field, select, formula, lookup, and linked-record mappings.
No Airtable records or credentials are stored in this repository.

tables.name: document_links
tables.description: Junction table for typed relationships between documents (e.g. attachment_of, response_to). Replaces a self-link field to allow multiple typed links per document.

tables.name: compliance_flags
tables.description: Discrepancy findings for documents (e.g. undeclared attachments, backdated registration). Severity falsification_risk marks strongest evidence-of-tampering cases.

tables.name: document_version_match
tables.description: Compares a user-submitted document with its court-registered counterpart to detect content substitution.
